# CRUD Module Generation

Scaffolds complete, production-ready CRUD modules following BERD.EM conventions with proper structure, patterns, and tests.

## When to Use

- **New feature module**: Building a new domain entity (e.g., Departments, Teams, Payroll)
- **Resource endpoints**: Need full CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) API
- **Time-saving**: Avoid repetitive boilerplate for standard patterns
- **Consistency**: Ensure new modules match existing BERD.EM patterns
- **Documentation**: Auto-generated Swagger decorators for API docs

## Prerequisites

- NestJS project with Prisma ORM
- Target entity already defined in `prisma/schema.prisma`
- Migration applied: `pnpm db:dev`
- Understanding of feature requirements (fields, relationships, validation rules)

## Core Workflow

### Phase 1: Gather Requirements

**Clarify the module scope:**

1. **Entity name** (singular, e.g., "Department", "TimeLog")
2. **Key fields** to expose in API responses
3. **Relationships** (many-to-one, many-to-many, one-to-one)
4. **Validation rules** (required fields, length, format constraints)
5. **Authentication required?** (typically yes — `JwtAccessGuard` is global, so it's on by default unless the route is `@Public()`)
6. **Authorization rules** (`@RequirePermissions({ action, subject })` — not CASL, that's dead code in this project — see which roles need the permission seeded in `prisma/seed.ts`)
7. **Hard delete or soft delete?** (this schema has no `deletedAt` anywhere — default to hard delete unless the feature has an explicit audit/undo requirement)
8. **Special features?** (bulk operations, filtering, conflict detection)

### Phase 2: Generate Module Structure

Create the folder structure with `.types.ts` and `.mapper.ts` files (BERD.EM pattern):

```
src/modules/department/
├── department.module.ts             # Module definition
├── department.service.ts            # Business logic
├── department.controller.ts         # HTTP endpoints
├── department.mapper.ts             # Domain → DTO transformation
├── department.types.ts              # Prisma includes + types
└── dto/
    ├── create-department.dto.ts     # Create payload (input validation)
    ├── update-department.dto.ts     # Update payload (input validation)
    ├── department.dto.ts            # Base response DTO
    └── department-response.dto.ts   # Extended response (inherits base)
```

**The `.types.ts` pattern centralizes Prisma includes:**

```typescript
// department.types.ts - Reusable Prisma includes and types
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';

// ✅ Define once, use everywhere (service, controller)
export const departmentWithEmployeesInclude = {
  employees: true,
  creator: { select: { id: true, email: true } },
} satisfies Prisma.DepartmentInclude;

// ✅ Type-safe payload for mapper
export type DepartmentWithEmployees = Prisma.DepartmentGetPayload<{
  include: typeof departmentWithEmployeesInclude;
}>;
```

**The `.mapper.ts` pattern transforms domain → DTO:**

```typescript
// department.mapper.ts - Centralized transformation logic
import { Department } from '@prisma/client';
import { DepartmentDto } from './dto/department.dto';
import { DepartmentResponseDto } from './dto/department-response.dto';
import { DepartmentWithEmployees } from './department.types';

export class DepartmentMapper {
  // 🧱 Base mapper - essential fields only
  static mapBase(this: void, dept: Department): DepartmentDto {
    return {
      id: dept.id,
      name: dept.name,
      description: dept.description,
      createdAt: dept.createdAt,
      createdBy: dept.createdBy,
      updatedAt: dept.updatedAt,
      updatedBy: dept.updatedBy,
    };
  }

  // 📦 Lite mapper - minimal fields for nested relations
  static mapLite(this: void, dept: Department): DepartmentLiteDto {
    return {
      id: dept.id,
      name: dept.name,
      description: dept.description,
    };
  }

  // 📊 Relation mapper - adds related data
  static mapEmployees(
    dept: Partial<DepartmentWithEmployees>,
  ): Partial<DepartmentResponseDto> {
    return {
      employees: dept.employees?.map((e) => ({ id: e.id, name: e.name })) || [],
    };
  }

  // 🚀 Main mapper (single entry point)
  static toDto(
    this: void,
    dept: DepartmentWithEmployees,
  ): DepartmentResponseDto {
    return {
      ...DepartmentMapper.mapBase(dept),
      ...DepartmentMapper.mapEmployees(dept),
    } as DepartmentResponseDto;
  }

  // 🔁 Mapper list
  static toDtos(
    this: void,
    depts: DepartmentWithEmployees[],
  ): DepartmentResponseDto[] {
    return depts.map((d) => this.toDto(d));
  }
}
```

### Phase 3: Write DTOs (Input & Output Validation)

**Base DTO contains all fields:**

```typescript
// dto/department.dto.ts - Base response DTO
import { ApiProperty } from '@nestjs/swagger';

export class DepartmentDto {
  @ApiProperty({ example: 1, description: 'Department ID' })
  id: number;

  @ApiProperty({ example: 'Engineering', description: 'Department name' })
  name: string;

  @ApiProperty({
    example: 'Building software products',
    description: 'Department description',
    required: false,
  })
  description?: string;

  @ApiProperty({ example: '2026-05-01T10:00:00Z' })
  createdAt: Date;

  @ApiProperty({ example: 1 })
  createdBy: number;

  @ApiProperty({ example: '2026-05-16T15:30:00Z' })
  updatedAt: Date;

  @ApiProperty({ example: 1 })
  updatedBy: number;
}

export class DepartmentLiteDto {
  @ApiProperty({ example: 1 })
  id: number;

  @ApiProperty({ example: 'Engineering' })
  name: string;

  description?: string;
}
```

**Response DTO extends base and adds relations:**

```typescript
// dto/department-response.dto.ts - Extended with relations
import { ApiProperty } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { DepartmentDto } from './department.dto';
import { EmployeeLiteDto } from '@modules/employees/dto/employee.dto';

export class DepartmentResponseDto extends DepartmentDto {
  @ApiProperty({
    description: 'Employees in this department',
    type: () => [EmployeeLiteDto],
    required: false,
  })
  employees?: EmployeeLiteDto[];
}
```

**Input DTOs with validation:**

```typescript
// dto/create-department.dto.ts
import { IsString, IsNotEmpty, MaxLength, IsOptional } from 'class-validator';
import { ApiProperty } from '@nestjs/swagger';

export class CreateDepartmentDto {
  @ApiProperty({
    example: 'Engineering',
    description: 'Department name',
  })
  @IsNotEmpty()
  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(100)
  name: string;

  @ApiProperty({
    example: 'Building software products',
    description: 'Department description',
    required: false,
  })
  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(500)
  description?: string;
}

// dto/update-department.dto.ts
import { IsString, MaxLength, IsOptional } from 'class-validator';
import { ApiProperty } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { PartialType } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { CreateDepartmentDto } from './create-department.dto';

export class UpdateDepartmentDto extends PartialType(CreateDepartmentDto) {}
```

### Phase 4: Implement Service (Business Logic)

**Service uses includes from `.types.ts` and mapper for transformation:**

```typescript
// department.service.ts
import { Injectable, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { CreateDepartmentDto } from './dto/create-department.dto';
import { UpdateDepartmentDto } from './dto/update-department.dto';
import { DepartmentResponseDto } from './dto/department-response.dto';
import { departmentWithEmployeesInclude } from './department.types';
import { DepartmentMapper } from './department.mapper';

@Injectable()
export class DepartmentService {
  constructor(private prisma: PrismaService) {}

  async create(
    createDto: CreateDepartmentDto,
    userId: number,
  ): Promise<DepartmentResponseDto> {
    const department = await this.prisma.department.create({
      data: {
        ...createDto,
        createdBy: userId,
        updatedBy: userId,
      },
      include: departmentWithEmployeesInclude, // ✅ Use from .types.ts
    });
    return DepartmentMapper.toDto(department); // ✅ Use mapper, not constructor
  }

  async findAll(): Promise<DepartmentResponseDto[]> {
    const departments = await this.prisma.department.findMany({
      include: departmentWithEmployeesInclude,
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });
    return DepartmentMapper.toDtos(departments); // ✅ Bulk transform
  }

  async findOne(id: number): Promise<DepartmentResponseDto> {
    const department = await this.prisma.department.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: departmentWithEmployeesInclude,
    });
    if (!department) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Department with ID ${id} not found`);
    }
    return DepartmentMapper.toDto(department);
  }

  async update(
    id: number,
    updateDto: UpdateDepartmentDto,
    userId: number,
  ): Promise<DepartmentResponseDto> {
    const department = await this.prisma.department.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        ...updateDto,
        updatedBy: userId,
      },
      include: departmentWithEmployeesInclude,
    });
    return DepartmentMapper.toDto(department);
  }

  async remove(id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.prisma.department.delete({ where: { id } });
  }
}
```

**Key patterns:**

- Always use includes from `.types.ts` (consistency + reusability)
- Return domain objects from service (let mapper handle DTOs)
- Use `Mapper.toDto()` for single objects, `Mapper.toDtos()` for arrays
- Throw standard exceptions (NotFoundException, BadRequestException)
- Include user ID in create/update for audit trails

### Phase 5: Create Controller (HTTP Endpoints)

**Controller with `@ApiBearerAuth()` and `@AuthenticatedUser()` for auth endpoints:**

```typescript
// department.controller.ts
import {
  Controller,
  Get,
  Post,
  Put,
  Delete,
  Body,
  Param,
  HttpCode,
  HttpStatus,
  ParseIntPipe,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import {
  ApiTags,
  ApiOperation,
  ApiResponse,
  ApiBearerAuth,
} from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { RequirePermissions } from '@common/decorators/permissions.decorator';
import { AuthenticatedUser } from '@modules/auth/decorators/authenticated-user.decorator';
import { AuthenticatedUserDto } from '@modules/auth/dto/authenticated-user.dto';
import { DepartmentService } from './department.service';
import { CreateDepartmentDto } from './dto/create-department.dto';
import { UpdateDepartmentDto } from './dto/update-department.dto';
import { DepartmentResponseDto } from './dto/department-response.dto';

@ApiTags('departments')
@ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
@Controller('departments')
export class DepartmentController {
  constructor(private readonly service: DepartmentService) {}

  @Post()
  @RequirePermissions({ action: 'create', subject: 'departments' })
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.CREATED)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new department' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 201,
    type: DepartmentResponseDto,
    description: 'Department created successfully',
  })
  async create(
    @Body() dto: CreateDepartmentDto,
    @AuthenticatedUser() user: AuthenticatedUserDto,
  ): Promise<DepartmentResponseDto> {
    return this.service.create(dto, user.userId);
  }

  @Get()
  @RequirePermissions({ action: 'read', subject: 'departments' })
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get all departments' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    type: [DepartmentResponseDto],
    description: 'List of all departments',
  })
  async findAll(): Promise<DepartmentResponseDto[]> {
    return this.service.findAll();
  }

  @Get(':id')
  @RequirePermissions({ action: 'read', subject: 'departments' })
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get a department by ID' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    type: DepartmentResponseDto,
  })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 404, description: 'Department not found' })
  async findOne(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
  ): Promise<DepartmentResponseDto> {
    return this.service.findOne(id);
  }

  @Put(':id')
  @RequirePermissions({ action: 'update', subject: 'departments' })
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update a department' })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    type: DepartmentResponseDto,
  })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 404, description: 'Department not found' })
  async update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateDepartmentDto,
    @AuthenticatedUser() user: AuthenticatedUserDto,
  ): Promise<DepartmentResponseDto> {
    return this.service.update(id, dto, user.userId);
  }

  @Delete(':id')
  @RequirePermissions({ action: 'delete', subject: 'departments' })
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete a department' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 204 })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 404, description: 'Department not found' })
  async remove(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number): Promise<void> {
    await this.service.remove(id);
  }
}
```

**Key patterns:**

- No `@UseGuards(JwtAccessGuard)` needed — `JwtAccessGuard` and `PermissionsGuard` are already global (`src/common/authz.module.ts`)
- `@RequirePermissions({ action, subject })` per route instead — and don't forget to seed that `(action, subject)` permission in `prisma/seed.ts` and grant it to a role
- `@ApiBearerAuth('access-token')` at controller class level
- `@AuthenticatedUser()` on endpoints requiring user context
- Use `ParseIntPipe` for ID parameters
- Service returns DTO directly (transformation already done by mapper)

### Phase 6: Register Module

Add to `src/app.module.ts`:

```typescript
// app.module.ts
import { DepartmentModule } from './modules/department/department.module';

@Module({
  imports: [
    // ... other modules
    DepartmentModule,
  ],
})
export class AppModule {}
```

Module definition:

```typescript
// department.module.ts
import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { DepartmentService } from './department.service';
import { DepartmentController } from './department.controller';
import { PrismaModule } from '../prisma/prisma.module';

@Module({
  imports: [PrismaModule],
  controllers: [DepartmentController],
  providers: [DepartmentService],
  exports: [DepartmentService], // Export if used by other modules
})
export class DepartmentModule {}
```

### Phase 7: Write Tests

**Unit test template:**

```typescript
// department.service.spec.ts
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { DepartmentService } from './department.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';

describe('DepartmentService', () => {
  let service: DepartmentService;
  let prisma: PrismaService;

  const mockDepartment = {
    id: 1,
    name: 'Engineering',
    description: 'Building software',
    createdAt: new Date(),
    createdBy: 1,
    updatedAt: new Date(),
    updatedBy: 1,
    employees: [],
  };

  beforeEach(async () => {
    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [
        DepartmentService,
        {
          provide: PrismaService,
          useValue: {
            department: {
              create: jest.fn(),
              findMany: jest.fn(),
              findUnique: jest.fn(),
              update: jest.fn(),
              delete: jest.fn(),
            },
          },
        },
      ],
    }).compile();

    service = module.get<DepartmentService>(DepartmentService);
    prisma = module.get<PrismaService>(PrismaService);
  });

  describe('create', () => {
    it('should create a department', async () => {
      const createDto = {
        name: 'Engineering',
        description: 'Building software',
      };
      jest.spyOn(prisma.department, 'create').mockResolvedValue(mockDepartment);

      const result = await service.create(createDto, 1);

      expect(result).toHaveProperty('id');
      expect(prisma.department.create).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        data: {
          ...createDto,
          createdBy: 1,
          updatedBy: 1,
        },
        include: expect.any(Object),
      });
    });
  });

  describe('findAll', () => {
    it('should return all departments', async () => {
      jest
        .spyOn(prisma.department, 'findMany')
        .mockResolvedValue([mockDepartment]);

      const result = await service.findAll();

      expect(Array.isArray(result)).toBe(true);
      expect(prisma.department.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        include: expect.any(Object),
        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      });
    });
  });
});
```

**E2E test template:**

```typescript
// test/department.e2e-spec.ts
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { INestApplication, ValidationPipe } from '@nestjs/common';
import * as request from 'supertest';
import { AppModule } from '../src/app.module';

describe('Departments (E2E)', () => {
  let app: INestApplication;
  let validToken: string;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      imports: [AppModule],
    }).compile();

    app = module.createNestApplication();
    app.useGlobalPipes(
      new ValidationPipe({
        whitelist: true,
        transform: true,
      }),
    );
    await app.init();

    // Get valid token from auth endpoint
    // This depends on your auth setup
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await app.close();
  });

  describe('POST /api/departments', () => {
    it('should require authentication', () => {
      return request(app.getHttpServer())
        .post('/api/departments')
        .send({ name: 'Engineering' })
        .expect(401);
    });

    it('should create a department with auth', () => {
      const createDto = {
        name: 'Engineering',
        description: 'Building software',
      };

      return request(app.getHttpServer())
        .post('/api/departments')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${validToken}`)
        .send(createDto)
        .expect(201)
        .expect((res) => {
          expect(res.body).toHaveProperty('id');
          expect(res.body.name).toBe('Engineering');
        });
    });
  });

  describe('GET /api/departments', () => {
    it('should return list of departments', () => {
      return request(app.getHttpServer())
        .get('/api/departments')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${validToken}`)
        .expect(200)
        .expect((res) => {
          expect(Array.isArray(res.body)).toBe(true);
        });
    });
  });
});
```

### Phase 8: Migrate & Test

1. **Run migration** (if entity is new):

   ```bash
   pnpm db:dev --name "add_department_entity"
   ```

2. **Run tests**:

   ```bash
   pnpm test department
   pnpm test:e2e
   ```

3. **Manual testing**:
   - Start dev server: `pnpm run start:dev`
   - Visit Swagger: http://localhost:3001/docs
   - Test endpoints with sample data

## BERD.EM Specific Patterns

### 1. Always Use `.types.ts` for Includes

```typescript
// ✅ DO THIS - Define once, reuse everywhere
const departmentWithEmployeesInclude = { /* ... */ };

// In service
async findAll() {
  return this.prisma.department.findMany({
    include: departmentWithEmployeesInclude,
  });
}

// ❌ DON'T - Duplicate include definitions
async findAll() {
  return this.prisma.department.findMany({
    include: { employees: true },
  });
}
```

### 2. Always Use Mapper for Transformation

```typescript
// ✅ DO THIS - Use mapper
const dept = await this.prisma.department.findOne(id);
return DepartmentMapper.toDto(dept);

// ❌ DON'T - Use DTO constructor
return new DepartmentResponseDto(dept);
```

### 3. Multiple DTO Versions

- **Base DTO** (`department.dto.ts`) - All essential fields
- **Lite DTO** (`departmentLiteDto`) - Minimal fields for nested relations (avoids circular refs)
- **Response DTO** (`department-response.dto.ts`) - Extends base, adds relations
- **Input DTOs** (`create-department.dto.ts`, `update-department.dto.ts`) - Validation only

### 4. Authentication Pattern

```typescript
// ✅ Endpoints that modify data
@Post()
async create(
  @Body() dto: CreateDepartmentDto,
  @AuthenticatedUser() user: AuthenticatedUserDto, // Get from JWT
): Promise<DepartmentResponseDto> {
  return this.service.create(dto, user.userId); // Pass to service
}

// ✅ Read-only endpoints (no user param needed)
@Get()
async findAll(): Promise<DepartmentResponseDto[]> {
  return this.service.findAll();
}
```

## Troubleshooting Guide

| Issue                       | Cause                                         | Solution                                                  |
| --------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| 404 on new endpoints        | Module not imported in app.module.ts          | Check `app.module.ts` imports array                       |
| Validation errors           | DTO missing validators or bad decorators      | Check `class-validator` + `class-transformer` imports     |
| N+1 queries in tests        | Missing `.include()` in service               | Add include to `.types.ts`, use in all queries            |
| Swagger docs missing        | Missing `@ApiOperation()` or `@ApiResponse()` | Add Swagger decorators to controller methods              |
| Mapper errors               | Type mismatch between domain and DTO          | Verify mapper handles all required fields                 |
| Test fails with Prisma mock | Mock not matching method signature            | Verify mock has correct structure (include, select, etc.) |

## Key Principles

1. **Single Entry Point for Transformation**: Use `Mapper.toDto()` everywhere
2. **Reusable Includes**: Define in `.types.ts`, import everywhere
3. **Type Safety**: Use `Prisma.GetPayload<>` for domain types
4. **Validation**: Always validate input with DTOs
5. **Relationships**: Always load related data (avoid N+1 queries)
6. **Documentation**: Use Swagger decorators for self-documenting API
7. **Testing**: Write both unit and E2E tests
8. **Authentication**: Use `@AuthenticatedUser()` for user context
